_comment: Ground truth read directly off in-game tooltips. This file OUTRANKS every scraped source (db.exil.es, db.ascension.gg, coabuildhub, ascensionsidekick). The builder consults it first for BOTH spell id and icon. Add an entry whenever a tooltip is screenshotted.

Convergence.note: 147 mana, instant. For 15 sec the next 10 Weapon Engravings deal +515 Elemental. db.exil.es returned 560241, which is the damage proc.

Primordial Fury.note: 171 mana, instant. Runic tattoos flare for 15 sec; Runeblade strikes 5 extra enemies; tattoos +100% effectiveness. db.exil.es returned 801095, a damage component.

Weapon Engraving: Fire.note: 73 mana, instant, 1 hour. 35% chance to ignite for 91 Fire per stack after 3 sec.

Weapon Engraving: Earth.note: 73 mana, instant, 1 hour. 20% chance for 86 extra Nature damage within 5 yds.

Weapon Engraving: Water.note: 73 mana, instant, 1 hour. 35% chance for 56 damage, drains 43 mana, grants allies Replenishment.

Weapon Engraving: Air.note: 73 mana, instant, 1 hour. 20% chance to replicate 45% of damage dealt.

Weapon Engraving: Arcane.note: 73 mana, instant, 1 hour. 30% chance for 163 Arcane and -30% healing received for 10 sec. db.exil.es returned 653263.

Weapon Engraving: Ice.note: 73 mana, instant, 1 hour. 45% chance for 159 Frost damage plus a movement slow. db.exil.es returned 653217.

Zenith.note: Base 712325 (122 mana, 45s). Taking Runelord REPLACES it with 712389 (134 mana, 2 charges, 45s recharge, +1% magic damage reduction) -- a different spell id, not just an extra charge, so an exact-id trigger on the base silently stops matching once talented.

Fists of Power.note: 206 mana, instant. Engrave your fists 15 sec; autos grant Earthen Fists 10 sec (+3% melee haste, +10% chance to trigger Weapon Engraving: Earth, stacks 5). db.exil.es gave 92153.
